correctness.rationale: For B=225, independently regenerated the 512 signed combinations of divisors {1,3,5,9,15,25,45,75,225}. Exactly eight nonzero coefficient-pair matches s+7t=0 occur at s=±329,±343,±371,±385 with multiplicities 1,2,1,2 per sign, totaling 12 distinct 18-divisor zero assignments. The two-level coin multiset D(B)∪7D(B) has sum 3224; direct subset sums cover 3..3221, hence every even signed total in [-3218,3218]. Recursing adjacent two-level blocks of powers 7^(2h) gives complete even intervals [-L_a,L_a], and ±47*49^a from top level overlap to cover every odd |k|<=K_a. For any a>=b, a seed realization uses levels 0..2b, and for each h=b..a-1 one of 12 distinct zero assignments on levels 2h+1,2h+2 independently, establishing R_{n_a}(k)>=12^(a-b) injectively. For odd numbers with <=2 distinct primes, sigma(n)/n<3/2*5/4=15/8 yields |signed imbalance|>=2n-sigma(n)>n/8, so fixed k cannot recur infinitely. Checks are exact on the finite two-level seed; induction proves all a.
